lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Five horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid formation posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal features running horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient consisting of a light peak above a dark shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin features a high density of small, stochastically distributed high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than those on the lateral flank.
